source: Child totals: USDA Expenditures on Children by Families (inflation-adjusted). Childcare: Care.com Cost of Care / DOL National Database of Childcare Prices. Private K-12: Private School Review. College: College Board Trends in College Pricing / US News.

child.note: Base annual cost is the USDA birth-to-18 total (~$300K inflation-adjusted, excluding childcare and education add-ons) divided over 18 years. Add-ons are windowed: childcare ages 0-4, private K-12 ages 5-17, college ages 18-21.

childcare.note: National average annual cost of full-time care for a child under 5. stateAnnual values reflect full-time infant care in metro areas (range ~$22K TX to ~$42K CT per Care.com).

privateK12.note: Elementary rate applies ages 5-13, high-school rate ages 14-17.

college.note: All-in annual cost (tuition + room/board + fees), used as the 529 funding target for ages 18-21.
